Row.Text: Rumours have begun to filter into the Palace that a monstrous beast stalks the city streets at the dead of night. Eye-witnesses claim that the beast is a demon, others claim it is the elusive wild haggis. Regardless, it is beginning to disquiet the city, and so the matter must be dealt with.
I shall hunt this beast myself; it shall pay tribute to my enduring grace as ruler.
Send out the guard and bring back the pelt of this beast.
I do not address mere rumours. I have an empire to run.
Capture it, put it in a zoo, and charge extra to have it seen.
